CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 11, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – February 11, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT CALENDAR:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES: January 28, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the January 28, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the minutes of the January 28, 2025, meeting of the
  Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board member Hernandez, Seconded by Board member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN Review Board DRB-24-100
  • 720 West Ramona Road

  1
   •  Applicant: Fanglu Jiang
  •  Request: This is an application for door and window removal, and
  window replacements on an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the proposed elevations to show a slider window at the
  northwest and west bay window, as seen in the current photos on
  the plans.
  2. Work with City staff on providing a proportional grid pattern for
  each bay window mentioned in Condition #1 and note that grids
  are to be permanently applied to the exterior of the glass.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.
  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-088
  • Address: 900 South Olive Avenue
  • Applicant: Richard Moran
  • Request: This is an application for a new front yard vinyl picket fence
  and gate, and new CMU wall and wall cap on top of existing CMU
  wall along the north property line of an existing single-family
  residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member [Name], Seconded by Board Member
  [Name].
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  2
   AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-086
  • Address: 121 East Adams Avenue
  • Applicant: Robert Yeh
  • Request: This is an application for a new 169 SF addition and exterior
  remodel of an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. If any part of the building that is to remain as presented and per
  approved plans (specifically the front portion) is demolished, then
  the entire project must go through Design Review Board again to
  get new approval before construction can continue, since the
  original design will no longer be valid.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. If any part of the building that is to remain as presented and per
  approved plans (specifically the front portion) is demolished, then
  the entire project must go through Design Review Board again to
  get new approval before construction can continue, since the
  original design will no longer be valid.
  2. Update the grid style for the arched window on the window
  schedule.
  3. Work with City staff on selecting a lighter value of color for the
  proposed stucco color on the main house.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised stucco color for City
  Architect to verify and approve.
  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:53 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on February 25, 2025.

  3
 ATTEST:
